messages.author: a259015b36a46546
messages.subject: Pardiso Windows
parts:
Hello, R-INLA developers.

Please I would like to know if pardiso windows version is out. Running a spde model on a windows server and I keep getting "Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : ". Unfortunately, the sensitivity and location of the data (DST server) means I cannot not run it on my pc using WSL or share the data.

I tried all the trick available on this forum e.g. 

res1 <- inla(form1, family = "binomial", Ntrials = 1,
            control.family = list(link = "logit"),num.threads="1:-1",
            data = inla.stack.data(stack.dat1), control.compute=list(openmp.strategy="default", smtp="default", dic=T,waic=T),
           control.inla=list(strategy="adaptive", int.strategy="eb"), verbose=T,
            control.predictor = list(
              compute = TRUE, link = 1,
              A = inla.stack.A(stack.dat1)))

but none works. 

Thank you

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Pardiso Windows
parts:
pardiso for windows? not yet.

You may run R under WSL in Windows, like

https://fedoramagazine.org/wsl-fedora-33/

which has been reported to run better (ie can take larger models) than
running it on Windows itself
